calculation_handling.description: The front yard setback of a townhouse or apartment building on a major street is measured from the lot line abutting the major street if the street has been built to the right-of-way width planned on Map 3 of the Official Plan.
calculation_handling.gaps: The tool does not hold whether the street is built to its planned right-of-way width.

calculation_handling.description: If the major street has not been built to its planned right-of-way width on Map 3, the front yard setback is measured from the lot line as it would be after the right-of-way widening is conveyed.
calculation_handling.gaps: The tool does not hold the planned right-of-way widening.

10.5.30.50(1).explanation: For a townhouse or apartment building on a major street, the front yard setback is measured from the lot line if the street is already built to the width planned on Map 3 of the Official Plan. If not, it is measured from where the lot line will be after the planned road widening is conveyed.
